infrastructure_project_type.label: Infrastructure project type
infrastructure_project_type.value: Communications infrastructure, power generation, electric power infrastructure, oil and gas infrastructure, civil and industrial construction, specialized foundations, and water and sewer treatment facilities.

public_private_client_mix.label: Public / private client mix
public_private_client_mix.value: Primarily commercial clients, including telecommunications carriers, electric utilities and energy companies, with some public-sector infrastructure work.

contracted_backlog.label: Contracted backlog
contracted_backlog.value: Backlog includes remaining work on project contracts and estimated work under master service agreements and other service agreements.

heavy_equipment_model.label: Heavy-equipment model
heavy_equipment_model.value: Owned and leased fleet vehicles and construction equipment.

project_delivery_duration.label: Project delivery duration
project_delivery_duration.value: Short-duration project contracts and multi-year construction projects, with multi-year master service agreements for recurring work.

fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.label: Fixed-price / cost-overrun exposure
fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.value: Fixed-price lump-sum and unit-price contracts expose MasTec to cost overruns. Some work is cost-reimbursable.

notes: Concession and long-term operating commitments are unclear.
